basics.name: Conor Hinchee
basics.summary: Senior software engineer with 5+ years building ecommerce applications in React, GraphQL and TypeScript. Owns the GA4 analytics code and leads AI adoption on the frontend team at Express, a storefront with about 5 million monthly users. Drops into unfamiliar codebases and ships, even the Swift iOS app.

skills.name: Frontend:
keywords: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Webpack, Storybook

skills.name: APIs:
keywords: GraphQL, Apollo Client, Apollo Server, Node.js, REST

skills.name: Testing:
keywords: Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, test-driven development

skills.name: Ops & AI:
keywords: GA4, TrackJS, Google Cloud Logging, Claude Code, MCP servers

highlights: Lead AI adoption on the frontend team: write the docs coding agents work from and teach developers to code with AI.
Built Quoth, an MCP server over our GraphQL and Java endpoints. Any Express developer can trace data end to end and get fast answers to questions like why a price or image isn't showing on a product.
Own the storefront's GA4 data layer and reporting pipeline.
Traced bad analytics data to a tracking bug in the Express iOS app and shipped the Swift fix through the iOS team's review, using AI to work in an unfamiliar codebase.
Co-maintain pure-react-carousel as one of four npm maintainers: about 67k weekly downloads and 1.7k GitHub stars.
Serve on the production on-call rotation through peak traffic like Black Friday: troubleshoot live issues with Google Cloud and TrackJS, lead incident response and write postmortems.

Led five contract developers through a summer-long move from Unbxd to Google Retail Search: wrote the tickets, ran the meetings, reviewed the code and wired the storefront to the new API through GraphQL.
Rebuilt the storefront's carousel and began contributing to pure-react-carousel: triaged issues and reviewed PRs.
Solved high-volume support issues on the first call for non-technical customers.

projects.name: Odin, Claude Code Skill
projects.description: Grew from a context-engineering experiment into a plan-to-PR pipeline for Claude Code with human approval gates. After each task, a look-back step proposes fixes to the skills and rules the agent follows, so the same mistake doesn't happen twice.

projects.name: heap-analyzer
projects.description: Finds memory leaks in Node.js apps by diffing heap snapshots. Built on Facebook's memlab and published on npm.
